articleTitle: YOLOv7 for Dental Caries Detection: Challenges in Small Object Identification
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: In countries like India, dentistry is often a neglected healthcare sector. Due to several factors such as poor eating habits, poverty, socio-economic challenges, illiteracy, and a lack of awareness, dentistry tends to take a backseat compared to other health fields. However, small lesions on teeth can lead to serious problems in the future. To address this issue, an "automated dental caries detection system" is proposed. A digital database of RGB images was developed using smartphones, comprising photos from 194 patients. Each patient contributed 5 to 6 images to ensure comprehensive coverage of the entire oral cavity. Under the guidance of a dental practitioner, these images were labeled to indicate dental caries stages and identify missing or fractured teeth (which were excluded from the study) using the Azure Custom Vision model. The images were then converted to the YOLO (You Only Look Once) format. YOLOv7 was implemented to detect the location of "dental caries". Although YOLOv7 performs well in object detection, it struggles to deliver satisfactory results with smaller objects, showing only 62% precision. While YOLOv7 excels in real-time object detection, it struggles with identifying smaller objects in dental images, leading to unsatisfactory precision.

articleTitle: Efficient Fingerprint Database Organization for Optimized Recognition
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: A popular biometric identification method, renowned for its dependability and individuality in personal identification, is fingerprint recognition. This article presents an efficient fingerprint identification system that significantly reduces processing times for 100,000 fingerprints from 8 minutes to less than 5 seconds by utilizing multithreading, ANSI 378 templates, and Source AFIS. The system overcomes the time-consuming image-to-template conversion procedure and increases overall storage efficiency by utilizing parallel processing and preformatted templates (ANSI/ISO). The fingerprint matching system incorporates Directional Field, CNN models for identifying fingerprint types, and Finger Code methods to classify fingerprints, improving precision and efficiency.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Community Detection and Network Analysis: A 2-Level Approach for Social Media Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: As social networking site users and their relationships generate enormous amounts of data, these networks become complicated, requiring sophisticated research approaches to extract valuable information. This research presents an innovative 2-level hierarchical method for community discovery. Greedy Modularity and Label Propagation community detection algorithms applied in the first level to find communities. Next, node similarity is assessed using similarity metrics such Jaccard, Cosine, Katz, and Adamic-Adar. These nodes are grouped utilizing K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) using common neighbors and vicinity to centroids once initial communities are identified, which refines the neighborhood framework to form a 2-tiered hierarchy. NetworkX visualizations for link prediction techniques used to highlight additional network topology insights. The proposed method improves on conventional community detection by identifying intricate hierarchical patterns, providing a more thorough comprehension of the dynamics of social media networks. The effectiveness of the presented hierarchical community detection methodology is assessed using quantitative indicators, such as F1 score, precision, and recall. The outcomes show the reliability of our approach in accurate community detection.

articleTitle: Indian Sign Language Detection in Virtual Reality using Leap Motion Controller
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Sign Language is a powerful tool that helps people with hearing and speech impairment to effectively communicate with normal people in real environment. Such people should also be able to communicate in virtual environments. The integration of Sign Language and Virtual Reality holds promise for breaking down communication barriers, empowering deaf individuals, and advancing accessibility and inclusion in virtual environments. It can enable them to fully participate in immersive environments. This paper focuses on the use of Leap Motion Controller and Virtual Reality devices for Indian Sign Language recognition, with the intention of increasing accessibility. Leap Motion Controller is used to capture Indian sign language gestures, that can be interpreted to text and thus providing people with a natural and expressive way to interact in Virtual Reality environments. The predicted alphabets and gestures are displayed in a Virtual Reality environment for visualization and better communication. EfficientNetB3, ResNet50 and Inception v3 are used for training the sign language data and prediction of correct gestures. Out of these models, EfficientNetB3 and Inception v3 achieved accuracies of 0.9984 and ResNet50 had an accuracy of 0.9987.

articleTitle: Implementation of Autonomous Vehicle using Real-Time Image processing and Computer Vision Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The recent development of autonomous vehicles has grown significantly, offering the possibility of safer and more effective modes of transportation. Enabling cars to travel and operate autonomously in real-world settings is a crucial obstacle to reaching complete autonomy. The proposed article uses image processing approaches and computer vision (CV) to resolve the difficulty of navigation and control in autonomous vehicles. Here in proposed investigate cutting-edge techniques for image processing and CV to retrieve useful data from the environment around the vehicle. It consists of obstacle recognition, lane detection, and object detection using different sensors like cameras.The proposed model aims to improve the vehicle’s decision-making capabilities by utilizing the image processing approach. The autonomous vehicle is able to make well-informed decisions regarding its speed, trajectory, and collision avoidance because it has an accurate perception of its surroundings. In addition, look into real-time image optimization and analysis to make sure the system is dependable and responsive in changing situations. The proposed model will improve global transportation system efficiency and safety while also advancing the field of autonomous vehicle technology.

articleTitle: Securing Automotives with Iris Pattern Recognition
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Cars and automotive theft are increasingly affecting today’s world hence implementing a smart locking system for luxury is must. Currently, there is a trend of biometric security and hence we have implemented an Iris pattern identification based locking system for the security systems of the car. Iris scans are based on the techniques of studying eye patterns and segmentations. Since biometric security provides maximum security, Iris scans are the most secure among all. The iris patterns are converted into unique mathematical forms that abdicate unambiguous positive recognizable proof of a person. Iris Acknowledgment viability is seldom hindered by glasses or contact focal points. This Biometric Security system for our automotive is the most efficient and optimal method in terms of security and other domains with stability as a key advantage. We have the Gabor wavelet transform based on Daugman’s algorithm for iris scans. As a result, auto motor optimization can be achieved by this technique and providing an immense level of security for the cars.

articleTitle: Unravelling Emotional Well-Being: Detecting Stress in Social Media Through Advanced Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Stress has become an almost constant part of our modern lives, it occurs due to communication with people on social networks, at work, and in other aspects of life. It is recommended to detect stress in the course of which timely interventions and preliminary mental well-being assessment are possible. In this work, we present approaches for stress classification in social media text using the RoBERTa model. Stress detection is a critical application area for RoBERTa since the model is designed to capture contextual insights in textual data. Our strategy builds on the RoBERTa model to extract language and contextual features of stress from text messages. Since the proposed scenario combines datasets of Reddit comments and tweets, it shows an enhanced accuracy of stress detection. Experimental outcome supports the hypothesis that RoBERTa functions well as stress-detecting in social media conversations.

articleTitle: Enhancing Real-Time Military Intelligence through LoRa and Advanced Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: This sophisticated real-time tracking system aims to promote soldiers' safety and well-being during military and peacekeeping operations through monitoring vital signs and location. The wearable, miniaturized device houses a heart rate sensor, temperature sensor, and GPS module that monitor cardiovascular condition, body temperature, and position constantly. The ability of this system to detect in an early stage such conditions as hyperthermia or hypothermia allows for a speedy response, and its ability to maintain situational awareness precisely is assured. An ESP32 microcontroller processes the sensors' data efficiently, i.e., heart rate, body temperature, and GPS location, and transmits them through a LoRa (Long Range) module. LoRa technology, chosen for its longer range and lower power requirement, is highly adaptable to faraway and difficult terrains. The system gives command centres crucial real-time information for a quick response in emergency situations and smooth coordination in the field. Through ESP32, LoRa, and multi-sensor integration, the solution is secure and scalable for health and location tracking, which is a remarkable development in military technology and an aggressive way to protect the health and success of soldiers.

articleTitle: EduMate: AI-Based Student Support Platform with OCR and Voice Assistance
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Advanced AI technology has been used in a timely and accurate manner to allow the children to get homework assistance through a digital learning platform designed to overcome the challenges in classes 1 to 6. OCR technologies like Tesseract, Keras-OCR, and EasyOCR are used to extract texts from handwritten texts and images on images and PDFs so as to ensure adaptability for diverse students' submissions. Google Gemini is utilized to create responses that will give a fast and accurate answer to the queries of students. It further uses the Naive Bayes with a spam detection mechanism and Nearest Neighbors guiding most relevant questions for deep learning in this personalized recommendation system. In this regard, it guides students through their homework and helps them learn in such ways that are as beneficial as possible. There exists a Decision Tree-based guidance mechanism here. It then applies state-of-the-art image pre-processing techniques such as contrast enhancement and filtering for OCR. The system is also multi-threaded and processes PDFs and images directly instance by instance, even in the most resource- demanding environments. This homework assistant makes AI intuitive, efficient, easily accessible, and enables processing in real time, personalized recommendations, and structured support for betterment of the study experience of young learners overall.

articleTitle: Classification of EMG-based Hand Gestures using Time and Frequency Domain Features
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Classifying hand gestures using electromyography (EMG) data has emerged as a crucial field of study, especially for its uses in human-computer interaction, rehabilitation, and prosthetics. This research presents a method for classifying hand gestures by analyzing Electromyography (EMG) signals using established machine learning algorithms, including Quadratic Support Vector Machine (SVM), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and Gaussian Naive Bayes. To identify five distinct gestures—pinch, open, fist, wave-in, and wave-out, three main features were derived from the EMG data namely band power, variance, and FFT power. These features serve as input to the classifiers for gesture recognition. Among the tested algorithms, Quadratic SVM demonstrated superior performance in accurately classifying the gestures compared to KNN and Gaussian Naive Bayes. Additionally, its short training time of 3.17 seconds enhances its potential for real-time applications, making it a strong candidate for systems like prosthetic limb control and robotic manipulation, where fast and reliable gesture detection is essential. This study’s findings suggest that the proposed framework is effective for realtime hand gesture recognition based on EMG signals, offering valuable potential in responsive, control-driven applications.

articleTitle: Towards Touchless Interaction: Implementing Hand Gesture Recognition for Presentation and Media Control
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The integration of hand gesture recognition with modern multimedia systems offers a novel and intuitive interface for users to interact with. This research implements a reliable framework for gesture-based control of slide presentations and media functionalities, using real-time hand detection and tracking through computer vision technologies such as OpenCV and cvzone. Recognizing individual hand gestures, the system allows for smooth navigation through slides in a presentation, annotating on slides, changing the brightness, managing windows like window minimization and maximization, and controlling media playback. The solution uses machine learning-based hand pose estimation along with optimal gesture mappings to make the recognition highly accurate and responsive. This research is meant to represent the possibility of hands-free interaction in professional and academic settings. The approach also studies applications in remote work scenarios, thereby increasing the incorporation of gesture recognition technology into everyday computing work. Moreover, the system is flexible and scalable and has the potential to integrate with virtual reality systems, remote learning platforms, and interactive kiosks. The proposed system, under controlled conditions, achieves an average accuracy of about 85 percent to 90 percent. It recognizes predefined hand gestures for navigation and interaction. When multiple gestures are shown at the same time, the system might experience temporary lags, but it recovers functionality within a few seconds. Thus, this research underlines the role of gesture recognition technology in transforming the way a user experience is provided.

articleTitle: Image Based Cancer Classification Using Metaheuristic Algorithms and Deep Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Computer-Aided classification of histopathological images is one of the best approaches used to achieve early and precise breast cancer diagnosis. In recent years, various researchers have been using transfer learning techniques for feature extraction. This research employs optimized deep features to address breast cancer image classification problems. This integration ensures more efficient feature selection and enhances the accuracy of the classification process. In this study, a two-stage image classification is proposed. Deep-Transfer learning (DTL) methods such as ResNet, ZF-Net, and GoogleNet extract the data from the image dataset. Next a Dragonfly Algorithm (DA) is used to select the optimal features. SVM, DT, and KNN are three distinguished classifiers implemented to evaluate the performance of the proposed model. The highest accuracy achieved with GooGLeNet-Svm is 0.991, while ZFNetSVM reaches 0.978, and ResNet-Svm attains 0.987. The experimental study results prove that the proposed method integrating DTL and the Dragonfly Algorithm, is more efficient than the existing one.

articleTitle: Enhancing Lung Diseases Prediction Using CNN ResNet-101 Model
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: This venture is targeted on growing an automatic gadget that predicts lung sicknesses from X-ray images using a deep mastering version. The version classifies pix into 4 classes: COVID-19, everyday, Pneumonia, and Tuberculosis. The system core is a Convolutional Neural community (CNN) the use of the ResNet-one hundred and one structure, pretrained at the ImageNet dataset and changed for lung disorder classification. X-ray photos are preprocessed and divided into training and validation units. The education procedure includes picture to enhance model effectiveness. The gadget become skilled using TensorFlow and Keras, using switch studying to shorten education time and decorate accuracy. The dataset is split into an 80-20 ratio for training and validation. version overall performance is assessed the use of accuracy, loss metrics, and a confusion matrix. Early stopping based totally on validation accuracy is implemented to beautify prediction reliability. The gadget generates a visual display of prediction probabilities for all ailment categories, along side a consumer-pleasant heatmap for studying confusion matrices. The very last model achieves aggressive accuracy and can be utilized as a diagnostic tool for healthcare specialists. A graphical interface has been created for users to add X-ray photos and consider prediction effects, showing the likelihood of each disorder. The mission showcases the effectiveness of deep getting to know in scientific imaging of lung sicknesses.

articleTitle: Innovations in Multi-Touch Attribution Models: Beyond Traditional Marketing Analytics in the Pharmaceutical Sector
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Measuring the effect of multichannel marketing strategies requires advanced algorithms which create unique challenges for the pharmaceutical industry's marketing efforts. The latest Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA) model evaluates multiple touchpoints within a customer journey and gains acclaim as the prime method for resource optimization. The study investigates the advanced MTA methods involving Shapley and Markov chain models and their practical uses in pharmaceutical marketing. The Shapley value uses cooperative game theory principles to distribute credit fairly among different touchpoints. Markov chains function to model the probability of sequential exchanges between customers and sellers. The Shapley value and Markov chain methods present more detailed results than those generated by standard last-click or heuristic-based models. The research paper presents an evaluative framework demonstrating these methods' functionality. Pharmaceutical companies using advanced MTA methods improve their management of intricate customer pathways and regulatory challenges. The study serves as a pathway that enables company marketers and data analysts to implement innovative tools to achieve improved results through strategic planning and resource distribution.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of YOLOv8 and Faster R-CNN in Fire and Smoke Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The increasing prevalence of wildfires poses significant risks to the environment, human life, and property. The heightened intensity and frequency of these fires underscore the need for effective early detection systems to enhance response efforts and reduce potential damage. Early detection is vital for preventing catastrophic events at the moment a fire ignites. This paper explores the utilization of Faster R-CNN and Yolo for the efficient and accurate detection of fire and smoke, leveraging advancements in machine learning and computer vision. Paper presents the Comparative Analysis of YOLOv8(small, medium, and large) variants and Faster R-CNN in fire and smoke detection. Results obtained for fire detection based on Precision, Recall, Accuracy, mAP@50, F1 score is as follows: Yolov8s(0.831, 0.856, 0.7272, 0.892, 0.8420), Yolov8m(0.817, 0.819, 0.6957, 0.864, 0.8205), Yolov8l (0.825, 0.841, 0.7264, 0.88, 0.8415) and Faster R-CNN (0.751, 1, 0.835, 0.740, 0.858). Faster R-CNN demonstrated better accuracy as compared to Yolov8.The performance of Yolo and Faster R-CNN exhibits variability due to differences in architectural design, methodologies employed for object detection, and the inherent trade-offs between speed and accuracy.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Comparative Analysis of Food Classification Using YOLOv8n, VGG19, and InceptionV3
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Food classification plays a vital role in areas such as food recognition, nutritional tracking, and culinary exploration. This study evaluates the effectiveness of three deep learning models—YOLOv8n, VGG19, and InceptionV3—utilizing the In-dian Food Classification Dataset and Food-11. Metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score indicate that InceptionV3 consistently delivers the highest accuracy, whereas YOLOv8n stands out for its real-time efficiency, making it well-suited for mobile or embedded systems. VGG19 provides a balanced performance but is limited by its larger model size and higher computational requirements. Statistical analysis (p ¡ 0.05) shows significant differences among the models, with confusion matrices revealing difficulties in classifying visually similar foods. The study suggests using InceptionV3 for tasks requiring precision, YOLOv8n for applications where speed is critical, and VGG19 for scenarios needing a balanced approach, while also proposing future research in cross-cultural food recognition, AI-driven food interaction, and personalized nutrition systems.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Stock Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Ensuring the accuracy of stock price predictions is crucial for maintaining financial stability and making informed decisions. The prompt identification of stock market trends and the factors that affect them is essential for developing effective investment strategies and promoting economic growth. In this paper, we introduce an innovative system that employs machine learning algorithms for real-time stock price forecasting, along with timely insights for investors. Utilizing advanced predictive models implemented through Python libraries such as TensorFlow and scikit-learn, our system analyzes historical stock data to forecast future trends, enabling proactive investment choices. By implementing this system in portfolio management, we equip investors to quickly adjust to marketchanges, thus enhancing financial stability and investment efficiency. The integration of machine learning techniques into financial decisionmaking offers a higher level of accuracy and flexibility in predicting stock prices. This helps mitigate risks, improve risk management, and ensures better returns for investors, contributing to sustainable economic growth. Through this approach, financial systems can achieve greater resilience, stability, and long-term success Indexed Terms: Machine Learning, Stock Forecasting, TensorFlow, Financial Stability.

articleTitle: Leveraging Transfer Learning for Object Detection in Medical Imaging
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The analysis of medical images is one of the key areas in the diagnosis of many conditions. However, because of the intricacy of medical images and the relatively limited size of many available datasets, traditional machine learning models are usually not as precise. Transfer learning has emerged as an approach to alleviate these problems as it relies on already existing models. This paper explores the latest advancements in transfer learning for medical image analysis, particularly in object detection. Object detection model YOLO (You Only Look Once) and its variants have gained substantial acceptance for their highly efficient architecture and improved accuracy. In this study, YOLOv8-pretrained on COCO dataset and the advanced version in YOLO family- is fine tuned for detection of leukemia cells in microscopic blood images. Model is trained and evaluated on ALL-IDB2 dataset using Google Colab. Data annotation and augmentation are used to improve the model performance. Experimental results are compared with existing state-of-the-art models, demonstrating that YOLOv8 outperform with 99.3% mean Average Precision(mAP). Our proposed model significantly improves accuracy, making real-time detection of leukemia cells more efficient.

articleTitle: IoT-based Prosthetic Arm Controlled by Human Gestures
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The need for affordable prosthetic solutions is huge in underdeveloped areas, where facilities of higher technology are unreachable to most amputated people. While much work has been done to develop different prosthetics, their prices and sophistication have limited accessibility and usage. The following is a milestone study that proposes the development of a gesture-controlled prosthetic arm using flex sensors together with ESP-NOW wireless communication technology. It is designed to be affordable and user-friendly, translating the user’s gestures into specific movements of the arm that allow self-sufficiency. The use of 3D-printed parts reduces both cost and weight, while the wireless communication framework increases portability. The proposed solution can mimic 32 human hand gestures and has 5 degrees of freedom (DoF). This research underlines the imperative of matching technological advancements with accessibility to improve the lives of amputees all over the world.

articleTitle: Prediction of Remaining Useful Life of the Space Rover Battery Using Fuzzy Adaptive Neural Learning Network
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Space rovers operate in extreme and unpredictable environments, requiring advanced systems for real-time health monitoring and failure prediction. This research presents a hybrid approach that integrates Fuzzy Logic and Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) to enhance the reliability and safety of rover operations, with a particular focus on predicting the Remaining Useful Life (RUL) of the rover’s battery. The Fuzzy Logic system deals with the uncertainties in the sensor data due to the rough conditions on Mars and assesses the environmental conditions, for instance, wind speed, temperature, and battery status while defining fuzzy sets and rules based on these variables for the overall risk-level assessment. At the same time, an ANN will be used to process the sequence of sensor data and predict the RUL of the battery. The ANN, trained on historical data, learns patterns that correlate environmental factors and system stresses with potential battery failures, providing predictive insights for proactive maintenance. This model meets its stated accuracy level and has performance metrics that indicate that the predicted RUL values are highly correlated to the actual RUL values. The Fuzzy Logic system provides the necessary comprehension for the risk assessment during a mission, while ANN can provide accurate predictions for the future ensuring that reliability is maintained. Adoption of these two approaches, FANLN for example, will enhance the rover’s capability to adapt to changing Martian environmental conditions, reduce risks effectively, and extend mission durations improving Martian exploration and colonization strategies.

articleTitle: Effective Vulnerability Reconnaissance for Content Management System Using Skip-Fish
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Content Management Systems (CMS) is the platform for creating sites and information handling in an organized way. As CMS contains the Files and Folders there might be many vulnerabilities hidden and must be identified at the earliest. To make the platform secure, the Penetration Testing exercise needs to be conducted before the site goes live. In the penetration testing exercise, the Reconnaissance stage is where testers could use various security scanners to trace the file structure for vulnerabilities. Vulnerabilities such as site misconfiguration, sensitive information disclosure, hard-coded values in files, banner disclosure, etc. are a few of the vulnerabilities that are likely to get promoted to the production environment in case the penetration testing is not conducted. Likewise, vulnerabilities related to infrastructure such as technology obsolescence, and component misconfiguration could lead to a weak entry point for the exploitation of the system. One of the well-known scanners is "Skip-Fish" which helps in scanning, crawling, and providing a comprehensive identification of vulnerabilities possibly exploitable. We will discuss about Skip-Fish scanner and understand its usage during the reconnaissance phase. The outcome of the scanner would provide the strategy for the other phases in the penetration testing activity. For performing penetration testing over a Content Management System (CMS) system, the Skip-Fish tool can be of significant help.

articleTitle: Improving Intrusion Detection Systems using Reinforcement Learning: Responding to New Cyber Attacks and Threats
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Cyber threats are evolving quickly, making traditional intrusion detection systems (IDS) less efficient at detecting and responding to new attack vectors. Cyber attackers constantly change their tactics, making rule-based systems unable to identify new threats. Intelligent solutions are needed. This study proposes using Reinforcement Learning (RL) to improve intrusion detection systems (IDS) to detect existing attacks and dynamically adapt to new cyber threats. Our method trains RL models to identify, classify, and respond to possible intrusions in real time, learning from previous attack data and simulated scenarios. The suggested system uses RL to learn from an environment with diverse security risks, allowing the IDS to continuously adapt its threat detection tactics without manual rule generation or regular updates. RL's capacity to evaluate and respond to new attack patterns makes it more flexible and sensitive to zero-day attacks and complex persistent threats, which traditional systems miss. The research describes the RL-based IDS architecture, including reward functions to improve detection accuracy and response efficiency. A case study using the model in real-world network environments shows improved detection rates and fewer false positives than standard IDS approaches. The study also examines Q-learning and Deep Q Networks (DQN) RL algorithms to determine the best way to train the system on labelled and unlabelled network traffic. To prove the system works, detection accuracy, false positive rates, and real-time response times are examined. The results imply that RL-based intrusion detection systems can improve network security, giving a potential alternative for organisations that must adapt to new and complex cyber threats. As cyber threats evolve, this approach can be used to build proactive, adaptive IDS that can handle new attack patterns.

articleTitle: Copyright information embedding using Steganography with Binary Lower Triangular Matrix
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: This project proposes a new way to manage digital rights using steganography techniques in Android social media apps. It embeds copyright information into media through a method called the Binary Lower Triangular Matrix. This ensures that information stays intact, even when the media is shared multiple times or compressed. When users upload content to social networks, the app quietly adds ownership details into the media. This hidden information doesn’t change during sharing. Because of this, the original application can still recognize and confirm who owns the content, no matter how it gets shared. The solution tackles the big problem of keeping control over copyrights in today’s fast-changing social media environment. It provides a strong & subtle way to safeguard digital assets.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Explainable AI Framework for Enhancing Trust and Transparency in Autonomous Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: This paper introduces a new hybrid framework for Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) aimed at enhancing the clarity and interpretability of decision-making processes in autonomous vehicles (AVs). A new hybrid framework is developed that integrates symbolic reasoning and Grad-CAM explanations to produce an in-depth understanding of the actions taken by AV. The experimental evaluation of the framework is done with the integration of real-world datasets like Waymo Open, KITTI, and BDD100K datasets along with virtual environments such as CARLA simulator. The outcome is that the framework delivers high fidelity explanations with an average Intersection over Union of 0.81 along with an interpretability score of 8.8 out of 10, which indicates the clarity and practicality of the explanations provided. Apart from that, the proposed framework delivers the real-time performance of 42 frames per second. Therefore, it is appropriately appropriate for safety-critical deployment in autonomous systems. More importantly, user trust is highly amplified as presented with inputs from subject matter experts and end-users. This includes erratic pedestrian behavior. This study is showcasing the hybrid XAI framework, which can make AV technology transparent, safe, and palatable, hence turning into an invaluable asset for applications involving AV in the real world.

articleTitle: Auralize: Text to Tune
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The fusion of music and technology has expanded rapidly. AI, machine learning, and signal processing are playing increasingly vital roles in music production, analysis, and generation. This framework introduces a comprehensive framework for automated music processing, including text-to-music generation, genre classification, and noise filtering. This model excels in complex classification tasks, efficiently identifies genre specific features, and achieves a high success rate in genre differentiation. Spectral Subtraction Noise Reduction algorithm refines the audio quality. It ensures that noise is reduced based on its unique characteristics, preserving clarity and maintaining the distinct elements that define various music styles. In conclusion, such an all-integrated system has potential for practical applications in the tasks like music indexing and retrieval or adaptive audio enhancement. Furthermore, this framework provides a basis for further improvements in intelligent music generation and classification.

articleTitle: HBPSO based Resource Scheduling for Optimization of Cost and Makespan in Cloud Data Centers
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Now present years, Cloud computing has emerged as a computational model for High-Performance Computing (HPC) applications, which deals with complex and highly intensive data. Cloud computing is a promising new style of scheduling environment which provides an scalable with on-demand supply methods to the consumers. In a cloud context, job or application scheduling is difficult and NP-complete. The objective of this work is to develop an algorithm to schedule for efficiently managing cloud resources besides finishing jobs with scientific applications applied in the Cloud Resource Broker (CRB) framework in Cloud Data Centre (CDC). The proposed HoneyBee based PSO (HBPSO) scheduling algorithm is deliberated for efficient resource allocation and henceforth the suggested optimization method anticipates to accomplish the objectives in minimizing both execution time and cost required to execute the job. It promotes resource allocation and job scheduling functions by balancing the load and reducing the skew, this in turn will eventually decrease cost, make span and resource utilization. Our goal is to transform the cloud datacenter to an efficient and effective datacenter in terms of time, cost and resource utilization so as to enhance the business values. By reducing completion times and costs while increasing the number of applications completed and user satisfaction, the simulation results utilizing Cloudsim and Cloud analyst demonstrate the efficacy of the suggested research work.

articleTitle: American Sign Language Recognition Application
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Through the applications of artificial intelligence (AI), the American Sign Language Recognition System (ASLRS)helps the hard of hearing by translating ASL gestures into voice or text. Due of the complexity of ASL's numerous hand shapes, motions, and expressions, the research employs deep learning techniques such as CNNs for gesture detection and Generative AI for contextual comprehension.The web-based program supports real-time operation, allowing users to enter gestures using a webcam or translate images or videos into text or voice. By using AI, computer vision, and human-computer interaction, the initiative seeks to increase communication inclusivity.

articleTitle: Improving Security Detection with Machine Learning: A Scalable Solution for Real-Time Vulnerability Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The sophistication of web applications has increased the attack surface of vulnerabilities, such as XSS and SQLi. Conventional detection methods include manual review and signature-based systems, which are inadequate to handle zero-day and emerging threats. The present study discusses a new framework of machine learning for vulnerability detection with improved accuracy and scalability. This minimizes the issue of false positives and false negatives at high rates during detection processes. The system will use a web application performing vulnerability real-time analysis; such analysis will be carried out on the usage of a preprocessed dataset, labeled with a preprocessed feature extracted by using Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF). There will be several machine learning models, that will be used, trained, and optimized to decide which one is the best for detection. Our proposed solution can process large datasets efficiently, keeping in mind computational performance versus detection precision, with an interface designed to provide user-friendly dynamic vulnerability analysis. The experimental results indicate substantial detection accuracy improvement, therefore this framework is a real transformation step in web application security.

articleTitle: Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis from Brain MRI Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: One of the major causes behind memory loss is a neurological disorder called Alzheimer's Disease. As of right now, there is no cure for this disease that can reverse or stop the disease progression. The development of an efficient model with high precision is vital for timely detection of the disease. Patients with Alzheimer's Disease are identified using different noninvasive or minimal invasive biomarkers such as Brain imaging, Bio fluid analysis and emerging biomarkers. MR imaging is to be considered as one of the noninvasive biomarker to look for evidence of memory impairment. Sometimes these indicators could be inexact when used as ground truth marking for Alzheimer’s Disease detection prior patient suffers from irreversible memory loss, which is why researchers have proposed multiple computer-aided methods. In this paper, an architecture of basic deep learning approached has been proposed. First approach uses the Convolution Neural Network design, while the second approach uses the VGG16 model, that utilized on the ADNI dataset with 3 progression stages such as Cognitive Normal, Mild Cognitive Impairment & severe stage of Alzheimer's Disease. These methods achieve impressive accuracy rates of 97% and 98% in effectively identifying and categorizing the progression levels of alzheimer’s disease. This technique can significantly contribute to improve alzheimer’s diagnosis and aid physicians in enhancing diagnostic accuracy by leveraging advanced computational techniques.

articleTitle: A Comphrehensive Approach to Power Management in Hybrid Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Worldwide, the amount of greenhouse gases and air pollution is increasing. Global forums are making great efforts to lessen reliance on fossil fuels. An early effort to less dependency on fossil fuels was the Battery Electric Vehicle (BEV). Further investigation is necessary to comprehend an EV's energy needs under different driving scenarios. The key factor influencing an electric vehicle's sustainable operation is its performance, which varies depending on the driving conditions. One of the most significant ways to save energy is through regenerative braking. This is true for systems including electric and hybrid vehicles (HEVs and EVs). Four distinct braking modes two of which are new are available. In order to improve the management methods of EVS-HEV, the research reported in this paper provides a novel theoretical basis for the use of EVs in HEVs. It then proposes a hierarchical controller that switches the braking mode using a rule-based control technique. Using MATLAB software, a simulation of the control approach is run. The findings demonstrate that the suggested control approach can enhance HEV RBS performance.

articleTitle: A Multimodal Anonymization Framework for MP4 Videos
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The increasing prevalence of video data containing sensitive information necessitates robust anonymization systems capable of safeguarding privacy across multiple modalities. This paper presents a comprehensive multimodal anonymization framework for MP4 videos, addressing privacy concerns related to text, facial features, and audio. The proposed system processes input videos by independently anonymizing embedded text, human faces, and audio streams through specialized pipelines while maintaining temporal and spatial coherence. Text anonymization leverages optical character recognition (OCR) for detection and employs redaction or pseudonymization techniques to ensure privacy. Facial anonymization uses advanced generative models to replace sensitive facial regions with realistic, privacy-preserving synthetic alternatives. Audio anonymization modifies speaker-specific features to eliminate re-identification risks while retaining semantic integrity. The anonymized components are recombined into a coherent output video, ensuring usability for downstream tasks. Experimental results demonstrate the system’s ability to achieve high privacy protection without significant degradation in video utility. This framework is highly relevant for privacy-preserving applications in healthcare, legal systems, social media, and machine learning datasets.

articleTitle: Implementation and Functional Verification of I2C, SPI and CAN frame protocols
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Software-Defined Vehicles (SDVs) have recently paved the way for a novel approach in the automotive industry where most of the vehicle’s functionalities are controlled through software. This transition requires that the EE architecture be optimized so as to support efficient and reliable inter-subsystem communication. Specifically, this research addresses performance optimization of EE architecture specifically through evaluating and fundamental building blocks such as I2C, SPI, and CAN frame protocols. Inter Integrated (I2C) and Serial Peripheral (SPI) interfacing and protocols are widely used for short range intra system communication and both possess different merits and demerits depending on the requirements for speed, power consumption and complexity. On the other hand, CAN protocol plays a crucial role in real-time communications in essential vehicle applications including powertrain, braking and infotainment. The analysis determines critical sources of inefficiencies and suggests appropriate configurations or protocol adjustments focused on increasing the data exchange rate and overall system dependability. This research work was carried out in Verilog since it gave the hardware description methodology for analyzing these protocols appropriately and it will improve enhanced system protocols in the embedded systems by improving the data transfer rate, minimizing power usage, and adequately developing the error control features. These are important objectives for real time application in Software-Defined Vehicles (SDVs).

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based CAPTCHA Verification Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: In the digital age, safeguarding online platforms against automated threats is increasingly critical. CAPTCHA systems have traditionally relied on text-based challenges, which humans can easily solve but are becoming less effective against advanced automated systems. To address this, we propose a novel CAPTCHA verification system that leverages deep learning and emoji recognition, offering a more secure and user-friendly alternative. This system utilizes a dataset of emoji images sourced from Kaggle, which undergoes preprocessing steps such as image resizing, normalization, and augmentation to Enhance the performance of a deep learning model developed using Python and executed within the Anaconda environment, is trained to recognize and interpret various emoji emotions, generating CAPTCHA challenges by displaying random sequences of emojis. Users interact with these challenges, and the model classifies their responses based on learned patterns to verify authenticity.

articleTitle: Micro-expression Analysis for Security and Law Enforcment using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Facial micro-expression recognition has become increasingly important in fields such as psychology, security, and human-computer interaction, due to its potential to reveal genuine emotions. Micro-expressions, lasting only 1/25 to 1/5 seconds, are crucial for applications in public safety, criminal investigations, and clinical medicine. These subtle and brief facial movements reveal hidden emotions, making them valuable for understanding human behavior. This paper presents a novel approach utilizing a hybrid Convolutional Neural Networks-Temporal Convolutional Networks (CNN-TCN) model for micro-expression recognition. The CASME2 dataset is used to train and evaluate the model, ensuring a comprehensive analysis of its performance. This study demonstrates the effectiveness of CNN-TCN in addressing the complexities of micro-expression recognition and contributes to advancing emotion recognition technologies, paving the way for improved human-machine interaction systems. It reviews the advancements in deep learning methods, discusses their challenges, and outlines future trends to guide ongoing research in this field.

articleTitle: Sign Language Recognition using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The substantial communication barriers faced by deaf or hard-of-hearing individuals who primarily use sign language create challenges for those who do not use it. Given that sign language can be difficult for non-users to understand, there is a pressing need for systems that bridge this gap. A real-time sign language recognition system is proposed, utilizing deep learning techniques, to accurately interpret various signs and convert them into written language. By employing a custom dataset and the MediaPipe framework for hand landmarks detection, the system processes input data through comprehensive preprocessing and training phases. The goal is to create an intuitive and efficient solution that enhances communication accessibility, promotes inclusivity, and empowers the hearing-impaired community to engage more fully with society.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach for Multi-Disease Diagnosis with ResNet50 and Spatial Attention
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Healthcare is an important factor in improving quality of life. Hence, early disease diagnosis is a must for proper treatment. The integration of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and deep learning has transformed the healthcare sector, enhancing the accuracy and timeliness of medical diagnoses, especially through medical imaging. This paper presents a Deep Learning-based approach for multi-disease diagnosis, where a single model classifies images of four diseases: eye, lung, skin, and brain conditions. The proposed model used ResNet-50 as a backbone with spatial attention. Spatial attention helps focus the model's attention on relevant regions in medical images, while transfer learning applies pre-trained knowledge to avoid extensive labeled data and accelerates training. The model achieved a diagnostic accuracy of 90% and thus could be applied to real-world medical applications. Additionally, a comparison has been made between the proposed model and a few state-of-the-art models, which established that the proposed method gives better results as compared to the rest. It also shows how AI and its allied techniques can carry the vast potential to help advance diagnostics in the healthcare sector.

articleTitle: Towards Precision Medicine: Deep Learning-Based Pulmonary Tuberculosis Detection in Radiographic Imaging
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The approach taken here uses a deep learning-based one for detecting pulmonary tuberculosis from chest radiographic images for the improvement of precision medicine in the diagnosis of TB. Our approach will use a CNN model and transfer learning in order to automate and enhance the accuracy of the process of detecting TB so that, consequently, clinicians can attain earlier and more reliable diagnosis. The proposed model was trained and validated on a large dataset of X-ray images with a 91.2% accuracy, 92.5% sensitivity, and 90.3% specificity. A comparative analysis has demonstrated that the superiority of the proposed model towards traditional methods involves a significant improvement in diagnostic capabilities for diverse patient populations. The research thereby underlines promising advancements of AI-driven tools for the amelioration of healthcare outcomes, especially in resource-limited settings where TB is commonly found.

articleTitle: Enhancing Respiratory Health with Smart Cooling Masks and Immune System Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: With this one pandemic from SARS-CoV causing havoc across the globe, wearing face masks has turned out to be one of the most effective and confirmed preventive measure. But standard disposable masks have no comfort features, things like adjustable straps, rough edges, insufficient nose padding, making it painful to wear for extended periods. It is especially difficult for people with respiratory disorders, who may experience effects on their respiratory system and immune response. To address these problems, we present the Smart Cooling Mask with Real-Time Human Immunity Level, a mask type wearable health monitoring solution. This one-of-a-kind device, a duck bill mask, is made of flexible, woven fabric and features an Independed removable Immunity Detector Device. It allows users to monitor their health and then provides useful step-by-step suggestions based on their immune system results to take further actions to improve their immune systems over timeThe system includes a closed-loop control system, as well as bio-sensors such as heart rate, blood pressure, pulse oximeter, and body temperature sensors which have an onboard microcontroller chip. Best of all, a dedicated smartphone app that pairs with the device allows you to control wear remotely, receive health alerts, reminders for mask maintenance, and health management in general.

articleTitle: Acoustic Emission Signal Localization in Steel Specimen Using Neural Networks with Multi-Sensor Feature Concatenation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The conventional acoustic emission (AE) signal localization algorithms in two-dimensions depend on velocity and time-of-arrival (TOA). Therefore, accurate calculation of such parameters is crucial. The difficulty is in identifying the velocity since they travel with separate modes depending on the element. Simultaneously, the complexity and computational time of the algorithms increases with the number of sensors. A novel localization algorithm is suggested to defeat these issues using a multi-sensor feature concatenation incorporated with a neural network (NN). Three sensors are used to capture the AE signals generated from a single pencil lead break-up test performed on a steel plate. After capturing, signal processing tools are employed to gather the required features. The fast Fourier transform is utilized for plucking out the frequency features, and the wavelet transform is applied to concurrently examine the signals in time-frequency domains. Then, the features are concatenated to construct the data set of the proposed localization algorithm. The input is the wave’s dominant frequency, TOA, amplitude, and duration, and the crack location coordinates are the NN model’s output. Results show that the proposed model achieves a mean squared and mean absolute error of 0.2313 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and 0.3463 cm, which is 81.77% more accurate compared to the conventional triangulation method, demonstrating robust localization performance without requiring explicit wave velocity estimation.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Evaluation of MIMO Systems for Next Generation Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The need for wireless communication has increased significantly in recent years. Despite the enhanced capabilities of Fifth Generation (5G) communication systems compared to Fourth Generation (4G) systems, they will be unable to meet the escalating demand and the needs of novel applications. Consequently, Sixth Generation (6G) Networks are anticipated to provide extensive connection and ensure improvements in performance and quality of service for all customers. This research examines the performance analysis of 16 QAM/QPSK in a multiple input multiple output (MIMO) system under diverse antenna designs and signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) situations, emphasizing its prospective use in 6G networks. Key performance parameters, such as bit error rate, capacity, throughput, and spectral efficiency, are assessed under both ideal (noise-free) and practical (noisy) settings. The findings demonstrate that massive MIMO systems, especially those equipped with extensive antenna arrays, provide considerable benefits regarding capacity and throughput, even amongst noise interference. The results illustrate the feasibility of massive MIMO for forthcoming 6G networks, where high capacity, low latency and dependable communication are essential prerequisites.

articleTitle: Optimizing Industrial IoT Predictive Maintenance Using Quantum Algorithms on Google Quantum AI
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) has transformed the concept of predictive maintenance by creating the possibility of real-time monitoring of machinery and equipment. However, the large volumes and complexity of data generated by IIoT sensors do pose significant challenges for data processing techniques. Quantum computing can be a transformative solution based on quantum algorithms that might improve predictive maintenance models. This paper discusses the integration of quantum algorithms on Google Quantum AI for optimising IIoT-based predictive maintenance systems. Techniques such as Quantum Support Vector Machines (QSVM) and quantum k-means clustering enable faster data processing and further enhance the accuracy of the anomaly detection process. Techniques such as Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) help in optimizing schedules for maintenance and resource allocation to reduce downtime and operational costs. Therefore, quantum simulations do better forecasts with the proper handling of equipment wear, and material degradation, bringing with themselves proper maintenance actions taken proactively. The real-time, parallel processing capability from the combined quantum computer and IIoT streams will lead to better, faster, low-cost maintenance decisions. Sustainably implemented quantum-fortified techniques are expected to give the least or no false positives, ensure events of unplanned downtime occurrence, and optimize maintenance resource usage. While further quantum advancement and breaking data integration challenges remain to be faced before reaching mass impact, now with the advancement of quantum technology it is possible to drastically change the landscape in the industrial space for predictive maintenance by revealing long-term efficiency gains in addition to cost savings. The paper unfolds potential advantages, challenges, and future direction on implementing quantum algorithms for IIoT-driven predictive maintenance systems.

articleTitle: Saathi : Smart Cane
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The smart stick has been termed as an innovative tool to help the visually and physically challenged, and it is far from the traditional white canes in that its framework avails an advanced technology to provide a full and instant sensory experience. This paper introduces a new concept of a smart walking stick designed to assist blind and visually impaired individuals, offering greater independence and safety. This unique cane offers better navigation guidance than standard tools, so users can travel comfortably through a variety of surroundings. In order to guarantee quick assistance when needed, it also has a mechanism for issuing emergency notifications. While current solutions provide some basic support, they frequently areunable to offer comprehensive help in complex situations. Our suggested smart cane overcomes these drawbacks and provides an affordable way to raise the standard of living for those who are blind or visually impaired.

articleTitle: Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem using Ant Colony Optimization and PuLP Library
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Routing determines the best path for resources or data to travel, essential in sectors like networks, telecommunications and transportation. Finding the most effective routes for a fleet of vehicles to provide goods or services while taking into account variables like vehicle capacity and speed is the goal of the Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP).Solving VRP optimizes resource use, reduces costs, and boosts operational efficiency. The VRP impacts delivery schedules, vehicle maintenance and driver workloads. Optimal VRP solutions enhance delivery reliability and timeliness, crucial for customer satisfaction and competitive advantage. The Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP) addresses real-world challenges by ensuring efficient load balancing and preventing overloading or underutilization. CVRP solutions improve fuel economy, reduce carbon emissions and create a more cost-effective, sustainable transportation system. In order to find the best route for a fleet of capacitated vehicles, we compare the PuLP library with Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) in this study. Our study aims to evaluate the efficiency of these two methodologies in solving the capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP), focusing on their performance in identifying the most efficient routes under given constraints. Based on the findings, the methodology that demonstrates superior performance will be implemented in the development of a user-facing system to optimize vehicle routing for practical applications.

articleTitle: Web-Kavach: Shielding Your Digital Life
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: "Web-Kavach" is an all-encompassing web application security tool developed to combat the increasing cyber threats faced by online users. It integrates four vital security features aimed at enhancing user protection. The ‘Breach-Scan’ service helps identify users about compromised credentials exposed in data breaches. The ‘Phish-Guard’ service analyzes email content to prevent phishing attempts. The Steganography service enables secure, hidden transmission of sensitive information within media files. Additionally, the password strength checker ensures the creation of strong passwords, minimizing the risk of unauthorized access. Together, these features strengthen web application security for users.

articleTitle: Encryption and Decryption of Different File Format Using AES
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: In the modern digital era, because encryption technologies have strong security features and are effective, they are essential for protecting sensitive data that is transmitted across networks or kept on different devices. The Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) is a prevalent technique for the secure encryption and decryption of digital information, employing an identical key methodology for effective data protection. Our implementation of AES encryption and decryption for several file formats is shown in this work. We examinet he difficulties and factors to be taken into account when encrypting and decrypting different kinds of information, including text, pictures, audio, and video. We also go over how important it is to select the right operating modes and key sizes for various file types in order to maintain efficiency and security. Our implementation aims to provide a comprehensive solution for securing sensitive data across different types of files, making it appropriate for a variety of uses.

articleTitle: Cloud-Integrated BLE Temperature Control and Monitoring System for Portable Transport of Temperature Sensitive Goods
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: An energy-efficient BLE-based real-time monitoring and logging system with temperature control for cold chain management of temperature-sensitive goods like vaccines and perishable items. Using an nRF52840 dongle running Zephyr RTOS, the system enables low-power Bluetooth communication. An Android application for continuous data visualization and compliance documentation. A PID-controlled Peltier module ensures precise, real-time temperature regulation and refrigeration with no moving parts, overcoming passive methods like ice packs while offering a cost-effective alternative to refrigerated transport. The COP of peltier device of proposed system has 2.1 units. This compact solution eliminates the dependency on Wi-Fi or cellular networks, making it ideal for e-commerce logistics and sensitive product transit.

articleTitle: Ambisync: An Internet of Things Approach to Room Energy Automation and Optimization
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The primary objective of this paper is to design and implement an intelligent room appliance management system that seamlessly integrates hardware and software components to optimize energy consumption and enhance user comfort. The system provides both manual and automated control over key room appliances, including air conditioners and lighting, through a mobile application and an automated hardware unit equipped with sensors and infrared (IR) controllers. The system's ability to adapt to varying conditions, such as changing temperatures and occupancy levels, has significantly enhanced energy efficiency. The novelty of this system lies in its integration of advanced real-time occupancy detection and environmental sensing, enabling appliances to respond dynamically to user presence and room conditions. By automatically deactivating appliances in unoccupied rooms, the system not only minimizes energy wastage but also contributes to sustainable energy management, offering a smarter and more efficient solution for modern living spaces.

articleTitle: Behavior Prediction and Anomaly Detection: Leveraging ML for Online Child Safety
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The rapid increase in harmful content online poses significant risks to child safety, emphasizing the urgent need for effective detection and prevention systems. This study explores the use of advanced machine learning (ML) techniques to tackle these challenges by integrating natural language processing (NLP) and computer vision models. Unlike traditional approaches, our methodology emphasizes the real-time analysis of both textual and multimedia content to detect harmful behaviors such as cyberbullying, grooming, and exposure to inappropriate material. By leveraging models like GPT-Neo, LightGBM, XGBoost, and Random Forest, this work achieves high accuracy in anomaly detection and content moderation. Additionally, the study addresses critical issues such as the scarcity of annotated datasets, language diversity, and the computational demands of real-world deployment. The findings underscore the potential of ML-driven solutions to create safer digital environments for children by providing comprehensive, scalable, and efficient protection systems.

articleTitle: Advanced Intelligent Pedestrian Crossing System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The increasing number of pedestrians in urban areas, coupled with the rise in road accidents, highlights the need for innovative solutions to enhance pedestrian safety. This paper presents an Advanced Intelligent Pedestrian Crossing System that leverages cutting-edge technology to optimize the safety and efficiency of pedestrian crossings. Utilizing an ESP32 microcontroller, Pulse Width Modulation (PWM), and advanced sensors, the system intelligently monitors pedestrian and vehicular traffic in real-time to regulate crossing signals. The core functionality of this system includes dynamic traffic light management, prioritization of emergency vehicles, pedestrian detection, and adaptive signal timing based on traffic conditions and pedestrian flow. The system integrates infrared (IR) sensors and cameras, to detect the presence of pedestrians at crosswalks and determine the most appropriate time to allow crossing. Furthermore, the use of PWM allows for efficient control of crossing signals and lighting, reducing power consumption while maintaining performance. By implementing this intelligent system, cities can reduce pedestrian-related accidents, improve traffic flow, and enhance overall road safety [1] [2].

articleTitle: Wild-Fire and Smoke Detection for Environmental Disaster Management using Deep Learning: Comparative Analysis using YOLO variants
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Wildfires significantly threaten ecosystems and the environment. The proposed research is driven by the need to enhance the early detection of wildfires using advanced deep-learning computer vision techniques. Experimental evaluation is done to address this issue, and results are demonstrated using YOLO (You Only Look Once) variants Yolov5custom, Yolov7custom, and Yolov8small. The proposed approach involves a comprehensive and rigorous comparison of trained models and their results to determine the most accurate model with optimal wildfire detection performance. Results obtained after training the models are as follows: Yolov5 custom performance measures are -Precision (P)-0.605, Recall(R)- 0.461, mAP@0.5-0.505, ii) Yolov7custom Precision (P)-0.619 Recall (R) -0.493, mAP@0.5-0.525, and iii) Yolov8 small Precision(P)-0.604, Recall(R) -0.500, mAP@0.5-0.521. Yolo8small demonstrated overall better performance in the detection of the fire. Through rigorous comparison of trained models, we have identified that Yolov8 small demonstrates superior performance in fire detection, with a precision of 0.604 and a recall of 0.500. This approach holds promise for improving the timely detection of wildfires and enhancing overall disaster management efforts, thereby offering hope for a more effective response to these natural disasters.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Diabetic Retinopathy Detection Using Preprocessed Fundus Images and Inception-v3
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is considered to be the leading cause of painful vision loss across the world, especially for patients with chronic diabetes. For this purpose, it is well known that prompt treatment is important for the prediction of the most advanced stages of the disease where the risk of partial or full sight loss is very high. However, the existing techniques used for diagnosis such as fundoscopy are inefficient because they are time-consuming, expensive, and require qualified doctors. This paper presents a novel approach for DR analysis based on deep learning and the Inception-v3 convolutional neural, which has been proven to be very effective for image recognition tasks. In particular, through the Inception-v3 framework, we would like to enhance DR screening accuracy and enhance the image of available fundus of retina for diagnosis. We used publicly available datasets for training and validation of our model and achieved significant performance gains with respect to classical diagnostic approaches. Furthermore, the proposed method also helps in decreasing the dependence of patients on the specialist and helps in extending the possibilities of screening in areas that have poor medical infrastructure. The study confirms the effectiveness of the Inception -v3 model in the detection of DR and its stages, thus, facilitating the development of automated diagnostics of retinal diseases.

articleTitle: Empowering Deaf Communication: "Deep Learning Framework for Sign to Speech Translation"
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The proposed system serves a real-time Indian Sign Language-to-text and speech translator that bridges the communication barrier for those individuals who are unable to communicate verbally. The system will use an advanced Transformer architecture with attention mechanisms that can selectively focus on critical features of gesture like hand shapes, positions, and motions, especially in complex environments, enhancing accuracy in static and dynamic movement recognition. All this is further complemented by CNNs, LSTMs, ViTs, and Mediapipe, all strengthening the capabilities of the system. NLP provides high-accuracy multilingual translation. The system also facilitates pose normalization and joint rotation correction ensuring the system's high recognition accuracy is maintained considering all conditions, fostering communication accessibility, and inclusivity in real-world settings.

articleTitle: Smart Prepaid Electric Meter System
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The rapid expansion of electrical grid systems underscores the critical role of smart metering in achieving operational efficiency and reliability. This paper presents a Smart Prepaid Electric Meter System using IoT technology to improve the management of energy use. The system comprises real-time monitoring, prepaid billing, and automatic power disconnection to reduce human intervention while ensuring that data is processed accurately and on time. This one will be easy to recharge and monitor usage while protecting the users' data with safe payment methods and secure communication in the cloud. The system will send timely alerts and low balance notices, thus promoting responsible use and increasing the efficiency of energy usage. It is very affordable, easy to grow, and simple to use. Soon it will connect with renewable energy, help solve some of the problems facing the world today- delayed billing, energy theft, and taking care of the environment.[1][2][4]

articleTitle: Medical Image Fusion Enhancement through Curvelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Medical image fusion, combining data from multiple imaging modalities, plays a crucial role in improving diagnostic accuracy, treatment planning, and medical research. The Curvelet transform, renowned for its ability to efficiently capture directional and multiscale information, emerges as a powerful tool for this task. This work provides a comprehensive overview of Curvelet transform applications in medical image fusion. We delve into the fundamental principles of the Curvelet transform, highlighting its advantages in the context of medical imaging. Furthermore, we explore various fusion techniques utilizing the Curvelet transform and showcase its successful implementation in fusing images from modalities like MRI, CT, PET, and SPECT. Finally, we identify current challenges and promising avenues for future research in this domain. The Curvelet transform's unique capabilities in representing multiscale, directional, and sparse data provide a robust foundation for advancements in medical image analysis and processing, including image enhancement, feature extraction, registration, segmentation, and, most significantly, image fusion.

articleTitle: Novel Distributed Approach for Next Best Offer using XGboost
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Product recommendations have become integral to business development and customer engagement strategies. While traditional techniques like market basket analysis are effective in retail, they are insufficient for the financial sector due to the diversity of banking products and the lack of direct dependency among them. This research paper proposes a novel distributed framework for developing an automated recommendation system leveraging XGBoost to predict banking product purchases based on categorized customer profiles. The framework integrates distributed computing technologies such as Hadoop for data storage and PySpark for scalable data processing. The system classifies customers into distinct categories based on their transaction history, demographic attributes, and banking behaviors to deliver personalized product suggestions. Model performance is evaluated using metrics such as the ROC curve, precision, recall, and F1-score. Empirical results demonstrate the system’s effectiveness in enhancing lead generation, targeting high-potential customers, and improving customer satisfaction in real-world financial markets.

articleTitle: Enhancing Passive Index Investing: Augmenting Volatility Harvesting with Machine Learning Models for Higher Returns
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Active fund management has traditionally dominated investment strategies but has increasingly faced scrutiny due to its inability to consistently outperform benchmark indices, prompting a shift toward passive index investing. While passive strategies simplify investment by mirroring market returns, they inherently cap the potential for higher gains and expose investors to market volatility. This study explores how dynamic portfolio rebalancing, combined with predictive insights from CNN-GRU hybrid and transformer-based machine learning models, can enhance returns while preserving the benefits of index-based investing. By employing volatility harvesting and market timing strategies at various time scales, the proposed approach augments portfolio weights dynamically (by a small amount of 2.5%), favoring equity indices during bullish predictions and reducing exposure during bearish forecasts. Through this methodology, we demonstrate improved risk-return profiles, highlighting the untapped potential of augmented volatility harvesting as a cost-effective, AI-driven investment strategy.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of RF Self Biased Ku Band LNA with Low Noise, High Gain
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: This paper reports on a self-biased, two-stage low noise amplifier with the application to Ku-band frequency range from 12 to 18 GHz.
